logs.stepTitle: Technical Design Report (TDR) Section 3 Compilation & Rulebook Audit
logs.description: Reviewed SIEP 2026 technical regulations covering high-voltage battery enclosures, mechanical crush zones, and roll hoop bracing dimensions. Formatted preliminary draft for Structural Equivalency Sheet (SES).
logs.achievements: Compiled 28 pages of technical documentation with verified CAD cross-sections and BOM cost calculations.
logs.blockers: Pending final TIG weld sample test certificates for Appendix D.

logs.stepTitle: Fabrication Progress Reel & Digital Identity Campaign Launch
logs.description: Filmed 4K macro footage of TIG welding on the AISC 4130 chassis node points, battery module casing assembly, and telemetry lab bench test.
logs.achievements: Published Instagram reel reaching 3.4k targeted collegiate engineering accounts; completed intro sequence for Episode 1 vlog.

logs.stepTitle: Corporate Sponsorship Pitch Decks & Industrial Partner Outreach
logs.description: Presented technical sponsorship proposals to industrial manufacturing and battery distribution partners. Prepared deliverables tier matrix covering logo placement, recruitment access, and testing day invites.
logs.achievements: Secured preliminary interest from two local precision CNC fabrication shops for upright machining support.
logs.blockers: Awaiting approved official endorsement letters from college administration.

logs.stepTitle: FEA Torsional Rigidity Analysis & Aerodynamic Drag Polar CFD
logs.description: Conducted ANSYS static structural simulation on roll hoop under 20g frontal and 15g lateral impact vectors. Meshed front fairing in OpenFOAM to analyze vortex shedding and cooling airflow.
logs.achievements: Chassis verified at 1,420 Nm/deg torsional stiffness with safety factor > 2.3 throughout critical nodes.

logs.stepTitle: CAD Surface Modeling for Aerodynamic Fairing & Driver Ergonomics
logs.description: Generated 95th percentile male driver packaging clearances in SolidWorks 2026. Modeled steering column angle at 18 degrees and validated cockpit ingress/egress 5-second exit requirement.
logs.achievements: Full 3D aerodynamic cowling envelope completed with clearance for 10-inch front wheels and steering lock.

logs.stepTitle: AISI 4130 Chromoly Spaceframe Jig Setup & TIG Root Pass Welding
logs.description: Notched 25.4mm x 2.0mm wall thickness chromoly tubes on mill. Mounted tubes into calibrated floor chassis jig. Executed argon-purged TIG root passes across front bulkhead and main hoop triangulations.
logs.achievements: Completed bottom frame triangulations within 0.8mm diagonal tolerance across all alignment check pins.
logs.blockers: Need fresh batch of ER70S-2 filler rods for front control arm brackets.

logs.stepTitle: 72V 40Ah Battery Pack Architecture & Smart BMS Configuration
logs.description: Assembled 20S battery cell modules with pure nickel strips. Wired cell voltage sense lines to Daly Smart BMS with RS485/UART interface. Bench tested active balancing at 3.35V nominal cell voltage.
logs.achievements: Verified pack isolation resistance > 500 Megaohms and safety disconnect contactor trigger under 12ms.

logs.stepTitle: CAN 2.0B Telemetry Bus Architecture & Digital Dashboard Loop
logs.description: Developed firmware for ESP32 CAN transceiver to decode BMS cell voltages, motor RPM, inverter temperature, and throttle position at 50Hz. Configured WebSockets bridge for live pit wall dashboard telemetry.
logs.achievements: Established stable 500kbps CAN bus communication with zero packet loss over 3-hour continuous stress test.
